title: Devils: contracts, mastery and rank
text: Canon devils: 26 devils each have their own look, arts and passives. Rank by price: Supreme (God Grade), High (Legend), Mid (Unique), Low (Rare). A devil may refuse the call: chance 35% Supreme, 55% High, 75% Mid, 90% Low (a relic of that devil helps). The contract asks Existence Points: Supreme 1 billion, High 100 million, Mid 10 million, Low 1 million; Dominance needs three times that and a won trial fight. One of one: a Supreme devil has one holder in the world. A lesser devil is shared by up to four holders and its power is split evenly. Contract kinds: Submission gives 25% of the devil's power, Even 50%, Dominance 100%. At most two Supreme devils per player; /devil terms explains everything. Devil Awakening and mastery: the contract gives an awakening skill whose mastery starts at 10% and only grows by using the devil. Mastery is the ceiling of your assimilation: 20% horns, 50% wings and flight, 100% the Devil Union. Awakening lasts 90 s at 10% mastery and 300 s at 100%, then you rest. Settings: nusmp-devil-phase2-server.toml; devil.legacyAssimilation restores the old instant climb.
